name: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys
short_description: Customer Insights - Journeys is the part of Dynamics 365 Customer Insights that uses customer profiles and audiences to send emails, text messages and other planned communications.

evidence.quote: Notice I'm saying customer insights data, not customer insights journeys.
Customer insights journeys helps a business decide who should hear from them, what message they should receive
Customer insights journeys uses customer information to plan and send communications
